anonymous.name: Anonymous
anonymous.bio: Works of unknown authorship from throughout literary history.

edwin-arlington-robinson.name: Edwin Arlington Robinson
edwin-arlington-robinson.bio: Edwin Arlington Robinson (1869–1935) was an American poet who won three Pulitzer Prizes for his work. He is best known for his short character poems and narrative verse.

eir-kr-magn-sson-and-william-morris.name: Eiríkr Magnússon and William Morris
eir-kr-magn-sson-and-william-morris.bio: Eiríkr Magnússon (1833–1913) was an Icelandic scholar who translated Norse sagas into English. William Morris (1834–1896) was an English designer, poet, and translator who co-translated several sagas with Magnússon.

george-webbe-dasent.name: George Webbe Dasent
george-webbe-dasent.bio: Sir George Webbe Dasent (1817–1896) was an English translator and folklorist who brought Norse sagas and Scandinavian folk tales to English-speaking audiences.

grammaticus.name: Saxo Grammaticus
grammaticus.bio: Saxo Grammaticus (c. 1150–c. 1220) was a Danish historian whose twelve-volume Gesta Danorum is the primary source for early Danish history and legend.

inazo-nitobe.name: Inazō Nitobe
inazo-nitobe.bio: Inazō Nitobe (1862–1933) was a Japanese diplomat, educator, and writer. His book Bushido: The Soul of Japan introduced the samurai code of ethics to Western readers.

joseph-conrad.name: Joseph Conrad
joseph-conrad.bio: Joseph Conrad (1857–1924) was a Polish-British novelist widely regarded as one of the greatest writers in the English language. His works explore the depths of human nature under extreme conditions.

peter-christen-asbj-rnsen.name: Peter Christen Asbjørnsen and Jørgen Moe
peter-christen-asbj-rnsen.bio: Peter Christen Asbjørnsen (1812–1885) and Jørgen Moe (1813–1882) were Norwegian folklorists who collected and published the classic fairy tales of Norway.

sturluson.name: Snorri Sturluson
sturluson.bio: Snorri Sturluson (1179–1241) was an Icelandic historian, poet, and politician. His Prose Edda is the most important source on Norse mythology.

william-blake.name: William Blake
william-blake.bio: William Blake (1757–1827) was an English poet, painter, and printmaker. Largely unrecognised during his life, he is now considered a seminal figure in the history of Romantic poetry and visual arts.
